```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(knitr)
opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r packages}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r data}
raw <- read.csv(here("stroop_flanker_raw.csv"))
```

```{r demographics}

```

```{r response trials only}
clean <- raw |> 
  filter(task=="response"|task=="stroop_response"|flanker_stim_type!="") |> 
  mutate(task = case_when(
    task == "response" ~ "rules",
    task == "stroop_response" ~ "stroop",
    task == "" ~ "flanker"
  ))

#check that each subj saw all three tasks
clean |> 
  group_by(subj_code) |> 
  summarize(n_tasks = n_distinct(task)) 

#check trials per task
clean |> 
  group_by(subj_code,task) |> 
  summarize(n_trials=n()) |> 
  summary() #always 96
```

```{r coding of scenario and text vs purpose violation for rules}
#import codingsheet
codingsheet <- read.csv("codingsheet.csv",sep=";")

#join 
library(fuzzyjoin)

clean <- regex_left_join(clean, codingsheet, by = c("stimulus" = "question"))

```

```{r yes vs no coding for rules task}
# key assignment only shown where applicable (rules)
clean <- clean |> 
  mutate(key_assignment = ifelse(task=="rules",key_assignment,NA))

#yes vs no coding for rules task
clean <- clean |> 
  mutate(rules_yeskey = ifelse(str_detect(key_assignment,"e for yes"),"e",
                                    ifelse(str_detect(key_assignment,"i for yes"),"i",NA))) |> 
  rename(response_input = response) |> 
  mutate(rules_response_verbal = ifelse(task=="rules" & response_input == rules_yeskey,"yes",
                           ifelse(task == "rules" & response_input != rules_yeskey,"no",NA)),
         rules_response_num = ifelse(rules_response_verbal == "yes",1,
                                     ifelse(rules_response_verbal == "no",0,NA)))

```

```{r select and order columns}
clean <- clean |> 
  select(subj_code,trial_index,task,stimulus,scen,rule,question,text_violation,purpose_violation,conflict,type,rules_yeskey,response_input,rules_response_verbal,rules_response_num,rt,correct_response,color,text,correct,flanker_stim_type,direction)
```

```{r tagging task-specific variables}
clean <- clean |> 
  rename(
    rules_scen = scen,
    rules_rule = rule,
    rules_question = question,
    rules_textviolation = text_violation,
    rules_purposeviolation = purpose_violation,
    rules_violationtype = type, 
    stroopflanker_correct_resp = correct_response,
    stroop_color = color,
    stroop_text = text,
    stroopflanker_correct = correct,
    congruent = flanker_stim_type,
    flanker_direction = direction
  )

```

```{r joint congruency variable}
clean <- clean |> 
  mutate(
    congruent = ifelse(task=="flanker",congruent,
                  ifelse(task=="stroop" & stroop_color == stroop_text,"congruent",
                    ifelse(task=="stroop" & stroop_color != stroop_text,"incongruent",
                      ifelse(task == "rules" & rules_textviolation == rules_purposeviolation,"congruent",
                        ifelse(task=="rules" & rules_textviolation != rules_purposeviolation, "incongruent",NA)))))
  ) |> 
  select(-conflict)

```

```{r some sanity checks}
#n participants in raw data
nlevels(factor(raw$subj_code))

#n participants in clean data
nlevels(factor(clean$subj_code))

#check that the missing 4 are noncompleters
noncompleters <- raw |> filter(!subj_code %in% clean$subj_code)


#each participant saw all three tasks
clean |> group_by(subj_code) |> 
  summarize(n_tasks = n_distinct(task)) |> 
  summary()

#and an equal number of trials per task
clean |> group_by(subj_code,task) |> 
  summarize(n_trials = n()) |> 
  summary()

#congruent and incongruent trials per task
clean |> group_by(subj_code,task,congruent) |> 
  summarize(n = n())

#rules: each participant saw 8 distinct scenarios
clean |> 
  filter(task=="rules") |> 
  group_by(subj_code) |> 
  summarize(n_scen = n_distinct(rules_scen))

#with 4 combinations of text and purpose violation per scenario
clean |> 
  filter(task=="rules") |> 
  group_by(subj_code,rules_scen) |> 
  summarize(n_type = n_distinct(rules_violationtype))

#check that reaction times make sense
clean$rt <- as.numeric(clean$rt)

clean |> 
  group_by(task,congruent) |> 
  summarize(median_rt = median(rt,na.rm=T))

#rules: check that judgments make sense
clean |> 
  filter(task=="rules") |> 
  group_by(rules_violationtype,rules_response_verbal) |> 
  summarize(n = n())


```

```{r export}
write.csv(clean,"clean.csv",row.names = F)

```
